expected_outcome: Reject (v1 hand review): The list runs a reanimation package (Animate Dead, Necromancy, Frantic Search). Reanimate is its cheapest payoff; Faithless Looting is only an enabler that costs a card. Obeka's end-the-turn ability makes you discard to hand size, which does not need looting. Swapping a payoff for an enabler adds no power.
